Market today: A cautious mood hangs over tech and growth. The real driver is a double whammy: Moody's warning on AI spending threatening big tech's credit quality, plus fears of rising long-term Treasury yields, both of which hit your concentrated tech/chip names hard.

Your holdings: SOXL (-46.24%) and SPAL (-55.51%) are leveraged, decaying ETFs with deep losses. Their default stops seem out of sync with current prices. QQQ (-4.26%) and QQQI (-6.52%) are also on SELL status and close to their stops. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a very close eye on the 30-year Treasury yield for any signs of breaking 6%. Also, monitor the price action around your QQQ and QQQI stops.

Bottom line: Focus on managing risk and respecting stops, especially on your leveraged and underperforming tech positions.
plays: Respect the QQQI stop at 52; it's very close and on SELL status.
Re-evaluate the SOXL stop at 200; it's a leveraged ETF deep in the red at 136.81, the current stop is not protective.
No new buys today - hold and watch. General market sentiment for tech is too uncertain.
